items.mainDefect: Anonymous clients can bypass the device limit by omitting the X-Grafana-Device-Id header, because TagDevice returns nil when it is missing.

secondary.defect: An unauthenticated attacker can send many random device IDs to fill the shared device limit, which blocks legitimate new anonymous viewers for up to 30 days (denial of service).

items.mainDefect: TagDevice now runs synchronously in Authenticate, so every new-device anonymous request runs a COUNT over 30 days of devices plus an upsert on the auth hot path.

secondary.defect: The DB work in TagDevice no longer has the bounded timeout context (or the panic recovery) that the old background goroutine had.

items.mainDefect: The updateDevice comment says it uses given times, but the function takes no time arguments and derives the window from device.UpdatedAt.

secondary.defect: The updateDevice comment does not mention that the function returns ErrDeviceLimitReached when no matching device row exists.
